attacked.target: The receipt of 400 USDC is classified as income from the transfer of a virtual digital asset, taxed at 30% under s.115BBH. The valuation date is the date of receipt (2026-06-18). The valuation method is the price that such property would ordinarily fetch on sale in the open market on the valuation date. No TDS obligation arises as the recipient is outside India. Under s.439(8), a disclosed position must be bona fide and all material facts must be disclosed.
attacked.attack: The provision cited for TDS obligations, s.309(1) Table Sl. No. 8(vi), is not current for the tax year FY 2026-27. The correct provision is s.393(1) Table Sl. No. 8(vi), which specifies the TDS rules for payments to residents.
